# function: numeric_state_trigger

Returns an automation `numeric_state` trigger, for use in `triggers`. `options` must set `above`, `below` or both; further trigger options, e.g. `attribute` or `for`, go there too.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A numeric state trigger; options must set above, below, or both.
locals {
  too_warm = provider::homeassistant::numeric_state_trigger("sensor.living_room_temperature", {
    above = 25
    "for" = "00:10:00"
  })
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
numeric_state_trigger(entity_id dynamic, options dynamic...) dynamic
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `entity_id` (Dynamic) Entity ID, e.g. `binary_sensor.motion`, or a list of entity IDs.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Dynamic) At most one object of further keys to set on the result, e.g. `{ name = "Kitchen" }`. Keys with a null value are left out. It must not set a key that another argument already sets.
